verdict.rationale: OpenHands supports running multiple agent tasks in parallel via asyncio.gather, workflow automations triggered on schedules/webhooks across Slack/GitHub/Linear, and PR/issue triage automations that could touch many items, suggesting some bulk/automation-depth capability. However there's no explicit documented feature for batch/bulk operations across many items (e.g., bulk file edits, bulk PR processing, multi-repo batch runs) as a first-class concept. missing for 10: dedicated bulk-operation API or UI, documented limits/performance at scale, independent evidence of bulk usage in production.
